dotfiles.notes: Source of the canonical sync skill; shares only the sync skill itself.

omni-notify.notes: Downstream consumer of @micthiesen/mitools; origin of the upkeep skill.

resources.notes: Shared shape only (sync remote -> survey -> research majors -> apply -> verify -> ship). Steps are environment-specific: omni-notify has a frontend workspace, Dockerfile, and LLM model IDs; mitools is a published library whose CI publishes to npm on a version bump. Port procedure improvements, never the project-specific steps.
Shared Oxc lint baseline and migration conventions; preserve each project's plugins, rule exceptions, and source exclusions. mitools also retains its separate strict Effect diagnostics gate.

Shared Oxc formatting conventions: two spaces, width 88, double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, and no package.json sorting. Preserve project-specific exclusions; mitools keeps its published legacy Biome config unchanged.
